description:
Welcome to the PHAF affiliate program! 

• About our brand and products:

We are Revolutionizing home furnishing by offering premium, direct-to-consumer furniture. Our core lineup includes the Phaf Bed, Nomo Sleeper Sofa, and Bro Single Sofa, all designed to deliver maximum comfort without the traditional retail hassle.


• What makes us different:

We completely eliminate the frustration of furniture assembly. All PHAF products feature a 100% tool-free setup that takes just three minutes. Furthermore, our innovative engineering allows full-sized beds and sofas to ship in compact boxes that easily fit through any doorway. Every purchase is backed by a 60-day risk-free home trial and a 36-month warranty.

• How affiliates can earn:

You will earn a competitive 8% commission on every successful referral. Because our AOV ranges between $400 and $900+, your earning potential per sale is highly lucrative. We also provide a generous 45-day cookie window, ensuring you get the credit you deserve even if your audience takes their time deciding.

• How to promote us:

Showcase the magic of our design! 

• Other information:

PHAF offers free shipping across the contiguous United States. As a partner, you will receive access to high-quality media assets, exclusive bundle promotions, and dedicated support to help you maximize your success. Join us in bringing smart, care-free furniture to everyone!
term_and_condition:
Welcome to the PHAF Affiliate Program! We are thrilled to partner with you.

By joining the PHAF Affiliate Program, you agree to the following terms and conditions. Please read them carefully to ensure you understand our guidelines and expectations.

1. Overview

This agreement outlines the terms of the relationship between PHAF ("we," "us," or "our") and the Affiliate ("you" or "your"). The purpose of this agreement is to allow you to make affiliate commissions by promoting PHAF products through your approved channels.

2. Payout Terms

  • Holding Period: Because we offer our customers a 60-Day Money-Back Guarantee, all affiliate commissions will be held in a "pending" status for 60 days after the sale date to ensure the product is not returned.

  • Returned/Canceled Orders: If a customer cancels their order or returns the product within the 60-day window, the affiliate commission for that sale will be voided.

  • Payout Schedule: Approved commissions are paid out monthly, usually on the 15th of the month, for all cleared sales from the previous period.

  • Minimum Threshold: You must reach a minimum of $50 in approved commissions to trigger a payout.

3. Promotional Guidelines

We encourage creativity! Unboxing videos, room makeovers, and honest reviews perform best. However, you must adhere to the following rules:

  • FTC Disclosure: You must clearly disclose your affiliate relationship with PHAF in all promotional content, stating that you may earn a commission from purchases made through your links/codes (e.g., using #ad or #sponsored).

  • Brand Representation: You may not misrepresent PHAF products, prices, or policies. All claims about our "tool-free assembly," "compact boxes," and "shipping times" must align with the information currently on phaf.shop.

  • Prohibited Content: You may not promote PHAF on websites containing illegal, violent, defamatory, or sexually explicit content.

4. Coupon & Discount Code Policy

  • Affiliates may only promote coupon codes that are exclusively provided to them through the PHAF Affiliate Program.

  • You may not post your affiliate codes on public coupon sites (e.g., RetailMeNot, Honey, CouponCabin). If your code is found on a discount aggregator site, it will be deactivated, and associated commissions will be voided.

5. Termination

Either party may terminate this agreement at any time, for any reason, with written notice. PHAF reserves the right to terminate your account immediately and forfeit any pending commissions if you are found to be in violation of these Terms & Agreement (e.g., spamming, trademark infringement, or fraudulent orders).

6. Agreement Acceptance

By submitting an application to the PHAF Affiliate Program, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to be bound by these terms.

*** Have questions? Please reach out to our affiliate management team at [Insert Affiliate Contact Email, e.g., Service@phaf.shop].
